title: Marble
description: Marble, in marble look cinematography, is stone as flesh: veined whites, cold polish, a statue that still breathes. They should look quarried: pale beauty skin without veins is not mineral.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Myths, fashion, a character already monumentalized: museum cold, a body that could be sculpture, architecture sharing the same mineral. 3D render is plastic-computer.
Marble is geology. It is the wrong tool as a desaturated beauty still, and the wrong tool if the surface is shader-perfect without veins.
You need veins, polish, and cold.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Great Beauty uses Roman stone as moral weather around bodies. The Belly of an Architect treats marble as both building and obsession.
Gallery sculpture is the well-known still grammar. Mineral as makeup, not a statue to clone.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Marble in film?
A mineral-flesh look: veined stone, cold polish, a statue that still breathes. Geology as skin, not a pale LUT.
Marble vs 3D Render
3D render is computed GI and too-perfect shader skin. Marble is quarried: veins, polish, museum cold. Plastic versus stone.
When should I use Marble?
Myths, fashion, monumental characters. Skip pale beauty with no veins.
How do I prompt Marble for AI image or video?
Gallery skylight, then: Marble look on [Subject], veined stone as flesh, cold polish, a statue that still breathes. Demand veins. Keep a breath of life in the face.
